text:
Anya (Product): Heads up — Nimbus (pilot customer) just asked to move their private pilot from beta -> staged launch in 6 weeks. They need 99.9% uptime, sub-120ms P95 gen on their typical 512-token queries, and HSM-backed key storage for model prompts. Can we sync owners + blockers?
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Whoa, 6 weeks is tight but doable if we scope launch to one model variant and enable prewarm + batching. Need infra commit for dedicated pool.
Devin (Eng - Infra): Agree. Dedicated pool + burst capacity needed. Quick question: expected concurrent QPS?
Anya (Product): They said ~60 sustained QPS, spikes to 220 during business hours.
Priya (SRE): For 60 sustained and P95 <120ms we should provision GPUs with low-latency network and ensure warm KV caches. I'll run a capacity projection.
Lee (Eng - Security): HSM requirement — we can integrate customer KMS via our KMS connector, but for HSM (FIPS-level) we need an onboarding window and audit config. Would like to know if the HSM is in their cloud or we host.
Anya (Product): They want us to use their HSM in their VPC (private deployment).
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Ok that means Private mode. We need a deployment plan: model quantization profile (int8) to hit perf target, enable prefix/KV caching, and a canary rollout path to hosted fallback if capacity issues.
Devin (Eng - Infra): Actionable asks for infra: (1) reserve 4x A100-like GPUs in their VPC for dedicated pool, (2) network peering + route setup, (3) autoscale policy tuned for bursts. Can we target week 2 for infra infra provisioning?
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Week 2 is fine if infra gives the pool. I'll prioritize quantization + scheduler tweaks — need 2 engineers for 3 weeks.
Lee (Eng - Security): For HSM/KMS onboarding, I'll need their attestation docs + access to a staging HSM. Can the customer provide a test token?
Anya (Product): I'll ask Nimbus to provide attestation and test tokens. Also they're open to a limited SLA scope (one region) for launch.
Priya (SRE): I'll add runbook items: canary thresholds, automated rollback at >2% error, alert thresholds for tail latency >140ms. Also will instrument per-route token-level cost dashboards.
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Quick config sketch for prewarm policy we discussed:
```yaml
prewarm:
  enabled: true
  min_workers: 6
  batch_timeout_ms: 8
  kv_cache_size_mb: 2048
```
Devin (Eng - Infra): Noted. Two infra risks: (A) network egress constraints in customer VPC, (B) quota on private GPUs from cloud provider. I'll open tickets and propose fallback: hybrid — keep 2 hosted warm nodes for overflow routing.
Anya (Product): OK owners: Mike -> runtime, Devin -> infra, Lee -> security, Priya -> SRE, Anya -> PM/customer.
Mike (Eng - Runtime): I'll create a PR with rollout plan + perf goals. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, measure P95 and errors. :thumbsup:
Devin (Eng - Infra): I'll start infra ticket and aim to complete provisioning by 2026-04-10.
Lee (Eng - Security): I'll prepare the HSM checklist and share with Nimbus.
Priya (SRE): Setting up synthetic load tests for 512-token mixes. ETA 1 week.
Anya (Product): Two final things — launch criteria (must pass perf + security checklist) and a go/no-go review 72h before scheduled launch. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30am.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create a staging deployment with tag `nimbus-pilot-01` once infra pool is available.
Anya (Product): Thanks everyone — please add calendar invites to the sync and paste any blockers in this thread.
Mike (Eng - Runtime): Noted. I'll post perf regression guardrails and a small benchmark snapshot in this thread later today.
Devin (Eng - Infra): Opening infra tickets now.
Lee (Eng - Security): Adding security checklist link: https://redwood.internal/security/hsm-onboard (draft).
Priya (SRE): I'll post initial capacity numbers by EOD. :coffee:
